summary: Soluna Holdings filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, announcing it received notice from Nasdaq of regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had been given until October 7, 2026, to cure the deficiency. Compliance was demonstrated by the closing bid price remaining at or above $1.00 from April 14 to April 29, 2026. This is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
